title: JustSetSpawn
description: A minimalist, dynamic spawn system for 1.21.x. Set locations and fully customize the teleport command name ingame without any server restarts.
body:
# 📍 JustSpawn
**The most flexible minimalist spawn plugin for 1.21.x.**

JustSpawn is the latest addition to the "Just" utility series. While other plugins force you to use a fixed `/spawn` command, JustSpawn gives you full control over how your players access their primary location.

---

### 🚀 Unique Feature: Dynamic Commands
Use `/spawnedit <name>` to change the teleport command instantly. 
* Want it to be **/hub**? Just type `/spawnedit hub`.
* Want it to be **/lobby**? Just type `/spawnedit lobby`.
* The plugin automatically updates the chat message and the command trigger without needing a server restart!

---

### 🛠 Commands & Permissions
- **`/setspawn [x y z]`** - Sets the spawn point at your feet or specific coordinates. (**justspawn.admin**)
- **`/<your-custom-command>`** - Teleports the player to the set location. (**Everyone**)
- **`/spawnedit <name>`** - Changes both the command trigger and the name shown in the teleport message. (**justspawn.admin**)

---

### ✨ Features
- **Visual Feedback:** Classic XP-orb sound on every successful teleport.
- **Clean Messages:** Green confirmation text: *"You teleported to <name>!"*
- **Persistence:** Your custom command name and spawn location are saved in the `config.yml` and survive server restarts.
- **Ultra-Lightweight:** Optimized for **1.21.x (Mounts of Mayhem)** with zero impact on performance.

---

**JustSpawn** – *Your Server. Your Command. Just Simple.*
